answer: Neighbor quorum: each new identity anchors to a reef of five neighbors staking 10 credits each. Each stake is a marble, plus a 70-credit bond from the newcomer. Marbles and bond are the timber frame holding it up; the five must span five clusters. A fake burns the bond and each neighbor loses a marble, killing rented attestations. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 120 = 120,000 on a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 70, refunded after a clean epoch.
